blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering requires determining whether a candidate article contains content that directly supports an answer under the applicable conditions of the question. We present DKnown-Jev-2, an article-level answer evidence classifier designed for evidence integration across multiple paragraphs. The model jointly encodes question conditions, article metadata, and paragraph content, and uses a pointer-style classification head to predict Answer Evidence (AE) and Non-answer Evidence (NE) in a single forward pass. Ona manually annotated test set of 972 evaluation instances, DKnown-Jev-2 achieves 91.77% accuracy and 91.28% macro-F1, outperforming Jev by 2.16 and 2.37 percentage points, respectively, while reducing both evidence misses and non-evidence false positives. The test set contains 317 multi-paragraph instances, with a maximum body length of 9,322 characters. Shared article encoding and non-autoregressive classification support low-latency inference. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method for article-level evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering.
blocks.zh: 在规范性知识问题回答中选择证据,需要确定候选文章是否包含在问题适用条件下直接支持答案的内容。 我们提出Dknown-Jev-2, 一个条款级的回答证据分类器,旨在将证据纳入多个段落。 该模型联合编码了问题条件,文章元数据和段落内容,并使用指针式的分类头来预测单向前传的回答证据(AE)和非回答证据(NE). Ona手动附加说明的测试集共972个评价实例,DKnown-Jev-2的精度为91.77%,宏观-F1的精度为91.28%,分别比Jev的精度高出2.16和2.37个百分点,同时减少了证据缺失和非证据的假阳性. 测试集包含317个多段实例,最大身长为9,322个字符. 共享物品编码和非自动递归分类支持低相关性推论. 这些结果表明,在规范性知识问题的回答中,拟议的条款一级证据选择方法是有效的。

blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering requires
determining whether a candidate article contains content that directly
supports an answer under the applicable conditions of the question. We
present DKnown-Jev-2, an article-level answer evidence classifier
designed for evidence integration across multiple paragraphs. The model
jointly encodes question conditions, article metadata, and paragraph
content, and uses a pointer-style classification head to predict Answer
Evidence (AE) and Non-answer Evidence (NE) in a single forward pass. On
a manually annotated test set of 972 evaluation instances, DKnown-Jev-2
achieves 91.77% accuracy and 91.28% macro-F1, outperforming Jev by
2.16 and 2.37 percentage points, respectively, while reducing both
evidence misses and non-evidence false positives. The test set contains
317 multi-paragraph instances, with a maximum body length of 9,322
characters. Shared article encoding and non-autoregressive
classification support low-latency inference. These results demonstrate
the effectiveness of the proposed method for article-level evidence
selection in normative knowledge question answering.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
In normative knowledge applications, determining whether a candidate
text provides an answer or part of an answer is different from measuring
semantic relevance to the question. Normative knowledge is issued,
maintained, or published by a responsible authority, and its
applicability depends on the subject, time, version, and other scope
conditions. A candidate text contributes evidence only when it is valid
under those conditions and provides an explicit basis for the requested
matter. Evidence selection therefore requires joint reasoning over
question conditions, article attributes, and textual content.
blocks.zh:
在规范性知识应用中,确定候选人是否
文本提供答案或部分答案不同于测量
语义上与问题的相关性. 发布规范性知识,
由主管当局维持或出版,
适用性取决于主题、时间、版本和其他范围
条件。 候选文本只有在有效时才提供证据
根据这些条件,并明确要求
物质。 因此,证据选择需要联合论证
问题条件、文章属性和文字内容。

blocks.en:
Candidate articles in practical systems commonly contain metadata and
multiple body paragraphs. Different paragraphs may jointly provide
eligibility, required materials, and procedural information, while also
containing tables of contents, duplicated text, or background
explanations. Compared with the single-paragraph data used in prior
work, the article-level data considered here requires extracting
evidence from longer text, integrating multiple paragraphs, and
distinguishing complete answers, partial answers, and background
information.
blocks.zh:
实用系统中的候选文章通常包含元数据以及
多个正文段落。 不同的段落可共同规定:
资格、所需材料和程序信息,同时
包含目录、重复文本或背景
解释。 与先前使用的单段数据相比
工作,此处考虑的条级数据需要提取
由较长的案文提供的证据,将多个段落合并,
区分完整答案、部分答案和背景
资料。

blocks.en:
We formulate article-level answer evidence identification as a binary
classification task over a user question, its applicable conditions, and
a candidate article. AE includes a complete answer or an explicit answer
component; NE includes contextual material, inapplicable content, and
material without substantive relevance. Each prediction analyzes all
paragraphs in the input article.
blocks.zh:
我们用二进制的答案来鉴定
用户问题的分类任务、适用条件以及
a 候选文章。 AE 包括完整的答复或明确的答复
内容; NE包括背景材料、不适用的内容,以及
材料没有实质意义。 每个预测分析所有
输入文章中的段落。

blocks.en:
Prior DKnown-Jev combines question conditions, article metadata, and a
single candidate paragraph under the same AE/NE label semantics [1].
This work extends the prediction unit to all paragraphs belonging to one
article and evaluates article-level classification on 972 instances. We
study overall classification performance and performance stratified by
the number of input paragraphs.

同AE/NE标签语义下的单一候选段落 [1] (中文(简体) ).
这项工作将预测单位扩展到属于其中一段的所有段落。
对972个案例进行条款级分类。 我们
研究总体分类业绩和业绩

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Retrieval-augmented generation uses external material to support
knowledge-intensive tasks [2]. Dense retrieval and cross-encoder
reranking provide complementary mechanisms for candidate recall and
relevance assessment [3,4]. Our task uses answer-support relations
and applicability conditions as the classification criteria.
blocks.zh:
回收的生成使用外部材料支持
知识密集型任务[2]. 紧急检索和交叉编码器
重新排序为召回候选人提供了补充机制
相关评估[3,4]。 我们的任务就是用回答支持的关系
将适用条件作为分类标准。

blocks.en:
Natural-language label definitions can participate in classification
decisions, while textual-entailment classification and text-to-text
learning provide related modeling perspectives [5,6]. We describe AE
and NE with natural-language definitions and determine the label from
matching scores between candidate representations and a decision
representation. Parameter-efficient adaptation methods such as LoRA
provide a practical route for domain adaptation [7].
blocks.zh:
自然语言标签定义可以参与分类.
决定,同时对文本进行分类和文本对文本
学习提供了相关的建模视角[5,6]. 我们描述AE
和 NE 中包含自然语言定义,并确定标签来自
候选人代表与决定之间的比分
代表权。 LORA等参数高效适应方法
为域名适应提供实用路线[7].

blocks.en:
3.2 Label Definitions and Decision
Criteria
blocks.zh:
3.2 标签定义和决定
标准

blocks.en:
A partial answer may provide an applicable definition, rule, condition,
material requirement, procedure, or concrete fact; the article need not
answer every aspect of the question. Related material may aid background
understanding without supplying answer content. A rule that does not
apply to the user and cannot support any answer component is NE.
blocks.zh:
部分答复可提供适用的定义、规则、条件、
实质性要求、程序或具体事实;
回答问题的各个方面。 相关材料可能有助于背景
理解而不提供答案内容。 不规则
适用于用户,不能支持任何答案组件为 NE。

blocks.en:
For example, consider the question: “What conditions and materials are
required for free repair of a Model A device?” A Model B repair policy
cannot serve as evidence for Model A even if the wording is highly
similar. The current Model A policy “A manufacturing defect occurring
during the warranty period is eligible for free repair” answers the
condition component and is therefore a partial answer. A valid
supplementary document stating “the purchase receipt must be attached”
provides another answer component. A paragraph that merely describes
after-sales-service principles is relevant background, not a procedural
basis. These cases illustrate the distinction between inapplicable
content, partial answers, and contextual references.
blocks.zh:
例如,考虑以下问题: “什么条件和材料
是否要求免费修理型号A装置?” 示范B修理政策
即使措辞很高,也不能作为模式A的证据。
类似。 现行示范A政策“制造缺陷”
在保修期内有资格免费修理”。
条件部分,因此是部分答案。 一个有效的
说明“必须附上购货收据”的补充文件
提供了另一个答案组件。 仅说明
售后服务原则是相关的背景,而不是程序性的
基础。 这些案例说明了不适用的区别。
内容、部分答案和背景参考。

blocks.en:
The decision uses both paragraph content and article metadata to
distinguish complete answers, partial answers, contextual references,
and inapplicable content, then maps them to AE or NE. Multiple
paragraphs may jointly support an answer. The labels encode
applicability and answer contribution under the given conditions; they
are not thresholded semantic-similarity scores.
blocks.zh:
该决定使用段落内容和文章元数据
区分完整的答案、部分答案、背景参考,
和不适用的内容,然后将其映射到AE或NE。 多个
该款可共同支持答复。 标签编码
在特定条件下的适用性和答复贡献;
非阈值语义-同义分数。

blocks.en: 3.3 Model Output
blocks.zh: 3.3 模型输出

blocks.en:
The model outputs a probability distribution over AE and NE together
with a predicted label. Metrics are computed against the manually
assigned label. In downstream answer generation, completeness, evidence
conflicts, and citation support must still be checked. When scope
information is insufficient to establish applicability, an application
may retain an unresolved status and verify it after additional scope
information is obtained; this status is not an additional label in the
binary evaluation.
blocks.zh:
该模型输出出一个概率分布在AE和NE之间
有预言的标签。 量度按手动计算
指定标签。 在下游的答案生成,完整性,证据
冲突,引用支持仍然必须检查。 当范围
信息不足以确定适用性,一项申请
可保留未解决地位,并在扩大范围后予以核实。

二进制评价.

The test set contains 972 manually annotated evaluation instances. Each

blocks.en:
4.2 Input Alignment and Evaluation
Integrity
blocks.zh:
4.2 投入调整和评价
诚信

blocks.en:
We compare DKnown-Jev-2 with Jev and OpenAI Decision. OpenAI Decision
denotes the decision service accessed through the OpenAI Decisions API
[8], which selects from predefined candidates and returns a
probability distribution. All three systems predict the same 972 test
instances, yielding 2,916 predictions. Predictions are aligned by
question, applicable conditions, and article content; each instance has
one reference label and three model predictions.

概率分布。 三个系统都预测 同样的972测试
实例,得出2 916个预测。 预测由
问题、适用条件和条款内容;
一个参考标签和三个模型预测。

blocks.en:
4.3 Task Complexity and Multi-paragraph Long-context
Inputs
blocks.zh:
4.3 任务的复杂性和多段长文
投入

blocks.en:
The dataset is substantially more demanding than the prior
single-paragraph setting. Its difficulty arises from evidence
identification under applicability constraints: users may ask about
several matters at once, answer clues may be distributed across
paragraphs, and valid evidence may be interleaved with tables of
contents, duplicated text, and incomplete sentences. The model must
locate and integrate answer components in longer text and then verify
applicability using regional, temporal, and article metadata.
blocks.zh:
数据集的要求大大高于以往
单段设置。 其困难来自证据
适用性限制下的识别: 用户可能询问
数个事项同时,答案线索可能分布在各地
和有效证据可与以下表格相隔
内容、重复文本和不完整的句子。 模型必须
找到并整合较长文本中的回答组件,然后进行校验
使用区域、时间和文章元数据的适用性。

blocks.en:
Multi-paragraph inputs account for 32.61% of the test set, including
12.96% with at least four paragraphs. These inputs require joint
reasoning over multiple paragraphs to determine whether the article
provides applicable answer evidence.

5 Model Architecture and Inference
Mechanism
blocks.zh:
5 示范建筑和推论
机制

blocks.en:
5.1 Backbone and Input
Organization
blocks.zh:
5.1 后骨和输入
组织

blocks.en:
DKnown-Jev-2 is built on Qwen3.5-9B [9] and uses a pointer-style
decision structure. Hidden states at candidate markers and a decision
marker are used by the pointer head to compute AE/NE scores. The input
contains the question and conditions, article metadata, paragraph
sequence, a classification instruction, and natural-language definitions
of AE and NE. A candidate marker terminates each candidate definition,
and a decision marker terminates the input sequence. Paragraphs are
serialized in order with their title and body; article attributes are
shared context. Marker indices are recorded during tokenization to
locate the final hidden states.

blocks.en:
5.3 Hybrid Attention and Cross-paragraph
Interaction
blocks.zh:
5.3 注意和跨段
互动

blocks.en:
In full-attention layers, the region from the beginning of the decision
context to the last decision marker is bidirectionally visible, allowing
candidate representations to use article context and compare candidates.
Linear-attention layers remain causal. The two attention mechanisms
jointly process question conditions, article paragraphs, and candidate
definitions. Consistent visibility rules are used during training and
inference, allowing candidate and decision representations to integrate
evidence distributed across paragraphs.

blocks.en:
5.5 Non-autoregressive Classification
Inference
blocks.zh:
5.5 非自动递减分类
推论

blocks.en:
Inference constructs the input sequence, records marker positions,
performs one backbone forward pass, extracts candidate and decision
representations, and normalizes classification scores. AE and NE scores
are produced simultaneously and converted with Softmax into a
probability distribution; the maximum-probability label is returned
without autoregressive decoding. Compared with the predecessor’s
separate article encoding for each candidate, organizing the article and
all candidate definitions in one sequence reduces repeated encoding and
token-by-token decoding overhead.

执行一次骨干前行通行证,抽取候选人和决定
说明,使分类分数正常化。 AE和NE分数
与软max同时生产并转换为a
概率分布; 返回最大概率标签
没有自动减码。 与前任相比
为每个候选人分别编订条款,组织文章和
一个序列中的所有候选定义都减少了重复编码和
代号逐个解码机顶.

blocks.en: 6 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 6 实验设置

blocks.en:
6.1 Baselines and Evaluation
Principles
blocks.zh:
6.1 基线和评价
原则

blocks.en:
We evaluate DKnown-Jev-2 against Jev and OpenAI Decision on the same
test set. All systems use the same AE/NE semantics and the same manually
annotated reference labels.

我们评价Dknow-Jev-2对Jev和OpenAI的决定
测试集。 所有系统都使用相同的AE/NE语义和相同的手动
注释参考标签.

blocks.en: 7 Results
blocks.zh: 7 结果

blocks.en:
7.1 Classification
Performance
blocks.zh:
7.1 分类
业绩

blocks.en:
DKnown-Jev-2 outperforms both baselines on all reported classification
metrics. Compared with Jev, it improves accuracy and Macro-F1 by 2.16
and 2.37 percentage points, respectively, adds 21 correctly classified
instances, and reduces false negatives by 17 and false positives by 4.
This indicates higher AE recall while preserving AE precision.
blocks.zh:
在所有报告的分类中,Dnown-Jev-2的效绩都超过两个基线
度量衡。 与Jev相比,它提高了精度和Macro-F1的2.16.
和2.37个百分点分别增加了21个正确的分类
将假阴性减少17个,将假阳性减少4个。
这表明,在保持AE精度的同时,有较高的AE回想.

blocks.en:
7.2 Complex Article
Scenarios
blocks.zh:
7.2 复杂条款
假设

blocks.en:
We stratify the test set into single-paragraph, 2–3 paragraph, and
4-or-more-paragraph groups.
blocks.zh:
我们把试验分为单段、第2至3段,以及
4-多段组。

blocks.en:
DKnown-Jev-2 has the highest accuracy in all three groups, reaching
92.67% and 92.06% in the 2–3 and 4-or-more paragraph groups. The
grouping is based on paragraph count; performance is also affected by
question content, class distribution, and applicability conditions.
blocks.zh:
Dknown-Jev-2在所有三个组中的准确度最高,达到
在2至3和4至多段组别中,占92.67%和92.06%。 这个
分组基于段落计数;业绩也受到以下因素的影响:
问题内容、类分布和适用条件。

blocks.en:
In the inference benchmark, on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 with 24 GB of
VRAM, the model has an average response time of approximately 118 ms with
concurrency set to one, providing low-latency evidence selection.
blocks.zh:
在推论基准中,以NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090为基准,24GB
VRAM,该模型的平均响应时间约为118 ms,与
货币设定为1,提供低相关性证据选择。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
We presented DKnown-Jev-2, an article-level answer evidence classifier
that jointly incorporates question conditions, article metadata, and
multiple paragraphs, and performs non-autoregressive classification with
a pointer-style head. The method shifts evidence selection from topical
relevance toward answer support under explicit applicability conditions
and extends the prediction unit from a single paragraph to an article’s
paragraph sequence. Experiments show improved evidence recognition in
complex article scenarios. Shared article encoding and
non-autoregressive classification reduce repeated computation and
provide a practical path to low-latency evidence selection. The model
can serve as an evidence-selection component in retrieval-augmented
generation by determining whether a candidate article supports an answer
under the given conditions.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了Dknown-Jev-2, 一个文章级的回答证据分类器
将问题条件、文章元数据以及
多个段落,并进行非自动后退分类
一个指针式的头。 方法将证据选择从专题转移
与明确适用条件下的答案支持的相关性
将预测单位从一款扩展至文章
段落顺序。 实验显示,证据识别在
复杂的文章情景。 共享文章编码和
非自动递减分类减少重复计算
为低相关性证据选择提供了一条实用途径。 模型
可作为检索中的证据选择部分
通过确定候选文章是否支持答案生成
在特定条件下。
